summaries.objective: Verify behavior of the Vitals module when the requirement-specified action is executed in the HealthCore EHR test environment.
summaries.verifies: verifies successful execution of the specified action in the Vitals module and resulting state update with audit logging
protocol: Open the HealthCore EHR test environment with a logged-in user in the appropriate role and the Vitals module active.
Execute the primary action specified in the requirement.
Verify the system response and state change.

summaries.objective: Verify audit log creation and field contents after executing the requirement-specified action in the HealthCore EHR test environment.
summaries.verifies: verifies completion of the specified action and creation of an audit log entry containing the required fields
protocol: Open the HealthCore EHR test environment with the audit log viewer open.
Execute the action specified in the requirement.
Query the audit log for recent entries.
Verify the log entry contains the required fields.
